meta.source: Wazn (وزن) — minimal rework, Nov 2026. Monochrome + one restrained brass accent.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page background (Paper / Graphite). Default ground for text and charts.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, panels, inputs: one step above surface-0.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: table header rows, zebra rows, code blocks, track of weight bars.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the mark's weights. 18:1 on surface-0.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, captions, axis ticks. 5.0:1 on surface-0.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Brand blocks and primary buttons. In light it is the near-black ink itself; in dark it lifts to a warm charcoal so blocks never vanish into the ground.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Secondary brand block and hover state of primary surfaces. Chart series 2.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Wazn Brass: the beam and fulcrum, outlined accent buttons, active weight bars, focus of attention. Fills and 24px+ type only; never body text.

tokens.name: brass-text
tokens.usage: Brass when it must be read: links, small accent labels, focus rings. 6.1:1 on surface-0.

tokens.name: brass-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet brass ground: selected rows, highlighted figures, callouts, accent-button hover.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-ink, brand-navy.

tokens.name: on-brass
tokens.usage: Text on brass fills.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, table rules, card borders. Decorative, not a control boundary.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons). Meets 3:1 non-text.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Gains, compliant (متوافق), filled orders. Always paired with ▲ or a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: positive-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for positive badges and gain highlights.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Losses, excluded (مستبعد), rejected orders. Tellable by lightness, plus ▼.

tokens.name: negative-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for negative badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Watchlist (تحت المراقبة), stale data, pending reconciliation.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for warning badges.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring (1.5px, 2px offset) on every interactive element.

families.display: "Readex Pro", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero lines, cover names. One per screen.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: الـ AI بيقترح، والقواعد بتقرر، وأنت بتوافق.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense UI, table cells, helper text.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Prices, weights, quantities in tables. Tabular, right-aligned.

spacing.note: 4px base grid. Use the steps; never in-between values. Minimal layouts lean on the larger steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls; table cell padding block.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding inline; table cell padding inline.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact); gap between related fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (default); gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections; logo clear space at 48px mark height.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page margins on desktop, cover insets.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Breathing room between major chapters in long documents.

radius.note: Near-zero. Wazn is a ledger: sharp corners, straight edges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, weight bars, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards, tables.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, app icon corners at small sizes, cover blocks.

shadow.note: Borders before shadows. One soft shadow, for things that genuinely float.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the approval sheet. Never on cards in a grid.
